arguments.name: viewport-demo
arguments.command:
set -e
prep() {
  echo "preparing step $1"
}
for step in one two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve thirteen fourteen; do
  prep "$step"
done
echo '--- log start ---'
for i in $(seq 1 200); do
  echo "log line $i of a deliberately long run"
done
echo '--- log done ---'

arguments.name: viewport-two
arguments.command:
set -e
say() {
  echo "second task step $1"
}
for step in red green blue yellow cyan magenta black white; do
  say "$step"
done
echo '--- second log start ---'
for i in $(seq 1 200); do
  echo "second log line $i of a deliberately long run"
done
echo '--- second log done ---'
